text: Two new taxes replace five old ones.
You get a credit for the tax you already paid.
Every purchase has tax in the price.

Well, it is a big change in taxes here in Brazil. Some old taxes go away, and there are new ones, with new names. It is going to take some years, I think. And companies can get some tax back, in some cases.

It is a reform that replaces five taxes. The CBS is the tax that replaces two federal taxes. The IBS is the tax that replaces two local taxes. The change is gradual: it starts in twenty twenty-six and it ends in twenty thirty-three. And companies that pay tax on their purchases get a credit.
It is a reform that replaces five taxes.
The CBS is the tax that replaces two federal taxes.
The change is gradual, from 2026 to 2033.
Companies that pay tax on their purchases get a credit.
The IBS is the tax that replaces two local taxes.
